summary: Iteration 7 focused on new multi-alarm system. Backend: 13/13 new pytest cases PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter7_alarms.py) — guest auth token, GET /api/alarms wrapper {data:[]}, POST once/daily/weekly, PUT update label+time+enabled, DELETE soft-delete (404 for unknown id, deleted rows disappear from list), validation (once without date -> 422 detail 'Pilih tanggal untuk alarm sekali.', weekly with empty weekdays -> 422 string detail, bad time '25:00' -> 422), per-user isolation (foreign guest token gets 404 on GET/PUT/DELETE), max 20 alarms enforced (21st -> 422). Existing suites (test_api_core 15/15, test_iter6_new_features 8/8) untouched. Frontend on 390x844 fresh guest login: intro-skip-button → guest-login-button → Home shows home-alarm-button card 'Bangun dengan dzikir'. Tapping opens Alarms screen with title 'Alarm dzikir', header alarm-add-button (+), empty state with alarm-empty-add-button 'Tambah alarm'. Add-alarm sheet 'Alarm baru' contains hour/minute wheels (alarm-hour-wheel-<n>, alarm-minute-wheel-<n> all tappable, tested with 6/15 and 5/45), alarm-label-input, repeat chips alarm-repeat-once/daily/weekly, dynamic alarm-date-YYYY-MM-DD chips for once (verified for tomorrow date), alarm-weekday-0..6 for weekly (default preselects Mon-Fri [1,2,3,4,5]), alarm-snooze-5/10/15, DZIKIR alarm-phrase-<i> chips + alarm-phrase-input free text, alarm-time-preview text ('Berbunyi besok, 15 Sep 2026 pukul 06.15 · dalam 12 jam 50 menit' for once, 'Berbunyi setiap hari kerja pukul 04.30 · dalam 11 jam 0 menit' for weekly), alarm-save-button. Once-alarm for tomorrow saved successfully -> sheet closed, toast 'Alarm disetel · berbunyi dalam 12 jam 50 menit.', alarm-card-<suffix> rendered with alarm-time-* + repeat label 'Besok, 15 Sep 2026' + alarm-switch-* toggle. Hero card at top shows alarms-next-time + alarms-next-until. Daily save produced 'Setiap hari' description; Weekly (default Mon-Fri) produced 'Hari kerja' description. Toggle alarm-switch-* OFF -> 'Nonaktif' text visible and hero updates; toggle back ON restores card. Edit via alarm-edit-<suffix> opens sheet titled 'Ubah alarm' prefilled with existing values; changing label to 'TEST edited daily' + save updates card. alarm-delete-<suffix> row action removes card and shows 'Alarm dihapus.' toast. alarm-preview-<suffix> opens full-screen overlay with badge 'PRATINJAU ALARM', alarm-ring-time, alarm-snooze-button, 'Tahan 3 detik · Matikan alarm' hold text, demo-close-button — snooze on web dismisses overlay cleanly. Focus tab (tab-focus) shows alarm-time, alarm-manage-button (navigates to Alarms), alarm-demo-button (opens demo overlay), alarm-edit-button (opens form). alarm-manage-button -> Alarms -> header-back-button returns to Focus tab. header-settings-button -> Settings shows settings-alarm-button labelled 'Alarm dzikir · 1 alarm aktif · tanggal, jam & pengulangan' and navigates to Alarms screen. 0 console errors during entire flow. All /api/alarms HTTP calls returned 200. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-audio, expo-notifications, expo-intent-launcher — all current; expo-av NOT used). No React red screen. No SafeAreaView deprecation issues.
critical_code_review_comments: Alarm CRUD is per-user via alarm_query(user) using user_id + deleted_at=None on every read/update/delete — verified isolation with two guest tokens (foreign PUT/DELETE returns 404, not 403; acceptable and prevents user enumeration).
Soft-delete design (setting deleted_at) means historical alarms are preserved server-side while disappearing from GET list; MongoDB compound index on (user_id, id) ensures fast per-user lookup.

Custom RequestValidationError handler correctly flattens Pydantic errors to a single string 'detail' and strips 'Value error, ' prefix — validated for all three 422 cases (once-without-date, weekly-empty-weekdays, bad-time).
AlarmInput.check_schedule normalizes weekly weekdays via sorted({d for d in weekdays if 0<=d<=6}) — deduplicates and clamps range in one pass; robust to client sending [7, -1, 1, 1].
Max-20 enforcement uses count_documents(alarm_query) which excludes soft-deleted rows, so users can churn alarms without hitting the limit erroneously.
Frontend AlarmFormSheet correctly guards 'weekly with no weekdays' locally before POST (setError 'Pilih minimal satu hari.') AND backend rejects — belt-and-suspenders.

Frontend NOTE (already correct): the once-past-time guard `if (repeat === 'once' && !preview)` is scoped to once only; weekly/daily can save even when today's time slot is past because next occurrence rolls forward — confirmed via 04:30 daily save when local time was past 04:30.
No deprecated Expo packages: uses expo-audio (not expo-av), expo-notifications, expo-intent-launcher — all match Expo SDK 57 current guidance.
seed_data_creation: All test data was ephemeral: each pytest test uses a fresh POST /api/auth/guest token; alarms are per-user so they auto-scope. The max-20 test creates 20 alarms on an isolated guest and does not affect other tests. Frontend test also used a fresh guest each iteration (localStorage.clear + reload).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL https://azam-islamic-app.preview.emergentagent.com (390x844). Auth = POST /api/auth/guest -> Bearer session_token (30-day TTL). Alarms endpoints: GET/POST /api/alarms, PUT /api/alarms/{id}, DELETE /api/alarms/{id} (soft). Native-only surfaces skipped: real OS alarm ringing / snooze scheduling (expo-notifications native), Android system-clock intent (expo-intent-launcher — button appears only on Platform.OS === 'android'). On web, an info banner correctly explains 'Di pratinjau web, alarm hanya tersimpan.' Regression check-list from iter1-6 (prayer times, Quran, Progress, Blocker, Share composer) is UNCHANGED — validated implicitly by 23/23 pre-existing pytest still passing and no console errors during the alarm flow which crosses Home hero + Focus tab + Settings screen. IMPORTANT gotcha for future automation: alarm form default weekdays = [1,2,3,4,5]; if you tap alarm-weekday-1..5 individually intending to 'select Mon-Fri', you'll TOGGLE them OFF and save will silently fail (frontend shows 'Pilih minimal satu hari.' error in the sheet). Either leave defaults untouched or first tap the currently-selected chips off before rebuilding the set.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs discovered. All 13 new alarm backend tests pass on first run; frontend flow (create x3, toggle, edit, delete, preview overlay, Focus tab integration, Settings integration) passes end-to-end with 0 console errors and all /api/alarms responses 200.
